node.title: Re: How to read serial port with Win32::SerialPort?
node.author: Discipulus
node.doctext:
Hello [mastertone] and welcome to (the number of writers in) the monastery!

Maybe unrelated but as you are on Windows and using a 64bit perl (assuming this from the path name) you might be interested in [id://1179150] leading to [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=113337#txn-1691722|this fix].

Also show the [METAMOD://Win32::SerialPort] version you are using, even if the last version in CPAN is 6 years holder than the above mentioned fix, so.. :)
